card.name: The word and after safety
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "safety" (or "Safety") in label phrases like "safety and effectiveness" or "safety and efficacy", mostly in pediatric use or dosing statements.

modes.label: Safety and effectiveness
modes.description: "and" follows "safety" at the start of a statement about whether effectiveness is established.
modes.example: Safety<< and>> effectiveness in pediatric patients younger than 2

modes.label: Safety and efficacy
modes.description: "and" follows "Safety" before "efficacy" in a statement about use not being established.
modes.example: Safety<< and>> efficacy has not been established for ACTIM

card.writes: It suppresses safety-related words, so the model does not repeat "safety" after "safety and" and instead expects a different word such as effectiveness.
card.plain: It fires on the "and" in "safety and effectiveness", the standard label phrase about whether use is established.
